fact: The BEAC strategy says CEMAC regulation No 04/18/CEMAC/UMAC/COBAC of 21 December 2018 on payment services governs payment establishments and mobile money across the CEMAC, which includes the Central African Republic.

The strategy says the 2018 CEMAC payment services regulation created payment establishments, licensed to provide payment services without being tied to a bank, and that mobile operator subsidiaries and fintechs can be licensed if they meet its requirements; it lists six licensed by July 2023 (2 Cameroon, 1 Chad, 2 Congo, 1 Gabon), none in the Central African Republic.
